lessons.title: Find One Object

play.shortDesc: Match one target picture inside a lively beach scene
play.targetObjective: Find the object that matches the picture.
stepByStep: Look at the target picture.
Scan one small part of the beach at a time.
Tap the matching object.
play.kidTip: Move your eyes slowly from left to right.
play.audioPrompt: Welcome to the beach. Look at the target, then find the matching hidden object.

lessons.pedagogyTip: A single exact target isolates visual matching and systematic scanning.

lessons.title: Find Two Objects

play.shortDesc: Keep two park targets in mind and find them in any order
play.targetObjective: Find both hidden objects in any order.
stepByStep: Look at both target pictures.
Choose one and scan the scene in sections.
Found objects become fully visible while you find the other.
play.kidTip: Find one target first, then look again for the other.
play.audioPrompt: Explore the city park and find two hidden objects in any order.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Two targets add working-memory demand while persistent opacity state reduces repeated search.

lessons.title: Find Three Objects

play.shortDesc: Scan a complete home scene for three targets
play.targetObjective: Find all three hidden objects without rushing.
stepByStep: Study all three target pictures.
Sweep the scene from top to bottom.
Check each corner before moving on.
play.kidTip: Split the scene into four parts and check each part.
play.audioPrompt: Look through the family home and find all three hidden objects.

lessons.pedagogyTip: A denser home scene rewards quadrant scanning rather than random tapping.

lessons.title: Look at the Shape

play.shortDesc: Use only an object's outline to locate it in the market
play.targetObjective: Match each dark shape to an object in the scene.
stepByStep: Study the outside shape.
Ignore colour and compare the outline.
Find all three matching objects.
play.kidTip: Look for corners, curves, handles, and long edges.
play.audioPrompt: At Market Street, use each silhouette to find three hidden objects.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Silhouette previews isolate contour recognition from colour cues.

lessons.title: Ignore the Look-Alikes

play.shortDesc: Compare small details while ignoring related objects
play.targetObjective: Find the exact objects and ignore the look-alikes.
stepByStep: Study the target's full shape.
Compare one visible feature at a time.
Reject objects that match only partly.
play.kidTip: Check shape first, then colour and small details.
play.audioPrompt: Look closely across the city places. Find the exact objects and ignore the look-alikes.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Related distractors require the learner to combine multiple visible features.

lessons.title: Find the Turned Objects

play.shortDesc: Recognize farm and forest objects after they have been turned
play.targetObjective: Find each object even when it points another way.
stepByStep: Study the target's important parts.
Imagine turning the object in your mind.
Find the same parts in the scene.
play.kidTip: The direction can change, but the object's parts stay the same.
play.audioPrompt: Search the farm and forest. Find the objects even when they are turned.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Large authored rotations build orientation-invariant recognition without reducing the effective touch target.

lessons.title: Same Object, New Size

play.shortDesc: Match school objects when their scene size differs from the preview
play.targetObjective: Find the same objects at different sizes.
stepByStep: Notice the object's shape and parts.
Ignore whether it looks larger or smaller.
Find all four exact matches.
play.kidTip: Size can change, but the shape and details still match.
play.audioPrompt: Explore the school. Find the same objects even when their sizes are different.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Controlled size variation separates identity from apparent scale while keeping every hit region accessible.

lessons.title: Find What Is Peeking Out

play.shortDesc: Recognize harbor objects when only part of each object is visible
play.targetObjective: Find all four objects from the parts that are peeking out.
stepByStep: Study the complete target picture.
Look for a matching edge or important part.
Imagine the hidden part and tap the exact object.
play.kidTip: A handle, point, or curve can identify the whole object.
play.audioPrompt: Search the harbor and aquarium. Find four objects from the parts that are peeking out.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Seventy-two percent visibility develops perceptual completion while retaining a fair identifying feature.

lessons.title: Search the Busy Scene

play.shortDesc: Separate five museum targets from dense exhibits and repeated shapes
play.targetObjective: Find five objects inside the busy museum scene.
stepByStep: Choose one target and remember its strongest feature.
Scan one museum section at a time.
Ignore background shapes that match only partly.
play.kidTip: Finish one small area before moving to the next.
play.audioPrompt: The science museum is busy. Search one section at a time and find all five objects.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Dense low-contrast exhibits increase figure-ground demand without introducing ambiguous exact duplicates.

lessons.title: Search the Castle

play.shortDesc: Hunt for royal treasures around the castle courtyard
play.targetObjective: Find every object hiding in the castle.
stepByStep: Look at the four target pictures.
Search the towers, then the walls, then the ground.
Tap each object you find.
play.kidTip: Check the shadows near the walls - things hide well there.
play.audioPrompt: Welcome to the castle. Find the four royal objects hidden in the courtyard.

lessons.pedagogyTip: A new place keeps figure-ground search effortful once earlier scenes feel familiar.

lessons.title: Find All the Frogs

play.shortDesc: One frog, hidden over and over around the castle moat
play.targetObjective: Find every frog before the count is full.
stepByStep: Look at the frog on the counter.
Sweep the scene one strip at a time.
Tap every frog until the count is full.
play.kidTip: Finish one strip of the picture before moving to the next.
play.audioPrompt: Frogs are hiding all around the castle moat. Find every single one.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Repeating one target shifts the work from recognition to systematic, exhaustive coverage.

lessons.title: Untangle the Pile

play.shortDesc: Tools piled on top of each other in the workshop
play.targetObjective: Find each object even where it lies under another.
stepByStep: Look at the target picture.
Follow one outline at a time where shapes cross.
Tap the object you traced.
play.kidTip: Trace the edge with your finger to see where one thing ends.
play.audioPrompt: Welcome to the workshop. The tools are piled up. Follow one outline at a time.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Pulling one contour out of another is a harder step than spotting a whole shape.

lessons.title: Same or Mirrored?

play.shortDesc: Half the hall is reflected, so check which way things face
play.targetObjective: Find the object facing the same way as the picture.
stepByStep: Look at which way the target faces.
Check whether the one you found faces the same way.
Tap only the matching one.
play.kidTip: A mirror swaps left and right but nothing else.
play.audioPrompt: Some things in the hall of mirrors are flipped. Find the ones facing the same way as the picture.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Rotation says an object stays the same when turned; mirroring says it does not. Holding both rules apart is the b-and-d skill.

lessons.title: Hiding in the Pattern

play.shortDesc: Reef creatures wearing the colours of the reef itself
play.targetObjective: Find the objects that blend into the reef.
stepByStep: Look at the target shape, not its colour.
Sweep slowly, because colour will not help here.
Tap the shape when you find it.
play.kidTip: When colour is gone, the outline is all you have.
play.audioPrompt: These reef animals wear the colours around them. Look for their shapes.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Removing colour as a cue forces the search onto shape alone, the way real camouflage works.

lessons.title: Follow the Shadow

play.shortDesc: At the lantern festival everything is a silhouette
play.targetObjective: Match each picture to its shadow.
stepByStep: Look at the shape of the target.
Find the shadow with the same outline.
Tap the shadow.
play.kidTip: Shadows keep the edge and lose everything else.
play.audioPrompt: The lanterns are lit and everything is a shadow. Match each picture to its shape.

lessons.pedagogyTip: A shadow strips colour and inner detail, leaving contour as the only evidence.

lessons.title: Find What Belongs

play.shortDesc: No picture this time, just a group to find
play.targetObjective: Find every object that belongs to the group.
stepByStep: Read or listen to the group you need.
Look at each object and ask if it belongs.
Tap every one that does.
play.kidTip: There is no picture to copy, so you have to know what the thing is.
play.audioPrompt: This time there is no picture. Find everything that belongs to the group.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Searching by category removes the template entirely: the child must recognise an object and judge it, not match artwork.

lessons.title: Spot Three Differences

play.shortDesc: Two pictures, three things changed
play.targetObjective: Find the three things that are not the same.
stepByStep: Look at the same corner of both pictures.
Move across a strip at a time.
Tap a thing that is different in either picture.
play.kidTip: Compare a small piece at a time, not the whole picture at once.
play.audioPrompt: Two pictures, almost the same. Find the three things that changed.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Comparing two scenes turns recognition into checking, which is a different and harder job.

lessons.title: Spot Five Differences

play.shortDesc: Five changes, and some are swaps rather than gaps
play.targetObjective: Find all five differences between the pictures.
stepByStep: Split each picture into four parts.
Check one part in both pictures before moving on.
Tap each difference you find.
play.kidTip: Something can change without disappearing.
play.audioPrompt: Five things changed this time. Some moved, some turned, some were swapped.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Adding turns and swaps means an object can differ without leaving, so absence is no longer the only cue.

lessons.title: Spot Seven Differences

play.shortDesc: Seven changes, including size and reflection
play.targetObjective: Find every difference, however small.
stepByStep: Work through the pictures in the same order every time.
Check size and which way things face.
Tap each difference until the counter is full.
play.kidTip: A thing can be the same shape but a different size, or facing the other way.
play.audioPrompt: Seven differences now, and some are only a size or a reflection. Take your time.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Every discrimination the earlier levels taught is now asked at once, against a second picture.

lessons.title: Hidden Object Challenge

play.shortDesc: Combine every taught strategy across the busiest places
play.targetObjective: Find all five objects using the best search strategy for each scene.
stepByStep: Study all five targets before searching.
Notice whether shape, direction, size, or a visible part has changed.
Search systematically and reject partial matches.
play.kidTip: Use the strategy that matches what changed in this scene.
play.audioPrompt: Take the hidden object challenge. Use every search strategy to find all five objects.

lessons.pedagogyTip: A controlled five-mode cycle measures independent strategy selection without time pressure.

lessons.title: Practice: Object Hunt

play.shortDesc: Ten independent searches across every place and taught mode
play.targetObjective: Find one target in each scene without hints or spoken directions.
stepByStep: The search skills you learned are mixed together.
Nothing is read aloud and there are no hints.
Study the target and search each scene carefully.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Ten one-target questions preserve comparable pace evidence while removing hints and opening speech.
